about: Zeus phone sign-in handoff site table. hosts: the ONLY hosts the handoff tab may be on and typed into (a host also covers its own subdomains, so walmart.com covers identity.walmart.com). start_url: where the tab opens when the engine's signin-sites.json entry is still a placeholder; once that entry is filled in, its account_url is used instead. The start_url values are best-effort public sign-in pages: check each once in Zeus's Chrome, or better, fill in signin-sites.json. store: the purchase lock store id, for its checkout-page patterns. Site ids match signin-sites.json and zeus-login. To use your own table, point config signin.sites_file (or HANDOFF_SITES) at a file of the same shape; a store whose sign-in lives on a parent company's domain lists both hosts.
